answer: Every newcomer locks a 300 POA bond in escrow and enters through a public referral thread that bridges them to a sponsor. Any peer may raise a dispute for a 20 POA whisper fee; five jurors check the thread, and a guilty verdict slashes the bond and the sponsor's stake together. Forging 1,000 identities costs 300,000 POA, versus 400 POA of rewards. An honest agent pays one bond once, keeps rewards undiluted, and earns it back after 20 epochs.
